Restore Zig 0.16.0 as the supported toolchain for stability.

## Changed

- Restore the implementation, examples, and build configuration from v0.1.0,
  before the Zig 0.17 migration.
- Require Zig 0.16.0 for this release. Zig 0.17 is not supported by this version.
- Keep the current Linux and macOS CI jobs and run them with Zig 0.16.0.
- Publish the restored implementation as v0.1.2; existing releases remain unchanged.

No new features are added.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen-anim/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
